source: PR STUDIO Unified Browser Agent 17.0.0 on the compatible unpacked-extension installation and pairing contract
installation_contract: same extension folder/load-unpacked/reload/pairing connection mode as user-supplied 2.0.0 baseline
pairing_contract: existing prstudioConfig/device token reused when still valid; re-pair required only after real revocation/expiry/deletion
sentinel_contract: legacy dedicated-window Sentinel is migrated away; tab ownership is lane/registry-based and adopted user tabs are preserved
screenshot_contract: preflight, bounded acquisition/CDP/API/upload timeouts, exact-tab local baseline capture, truthful fallback dimensions and released buffers
suite_15_migration: one-time ephemeral runtime cleanup preserving prstudioConfig, pairing and user-authored local assets
mv3_polling_contract: event-driven selector/url/SPA readiness in the interaction hot path; no fixed 80/100 ms polling cadence
runtime_session_contract: trace/video/HAR/route/coverage use expiring session ids and report interruption after MV3 restart instead of false completion
observation_memory_contract: persistent incremental semantic index with stable target refs, mutation-driven invalidation and byte-bounded observation buffers
popup_ownership_contract: owned opener inheritance with explicit cross-origin allowlist enforcement
page_runtime_contract: document-start resident runtime in every HTTP/HTTPS frame with long-lived per-frame Port; main-frame compatibility retained
native_input_hot_path: single ownership assertion + persistent debugger attachment + direct ordered CDP input dispatch without repeated domain enables/getTargets checks
frame_runtime_contract: parallel frame snapshots and semantic target ranking; frame-specific action routing; about:blank/srcdoc origin fallback enabled
oopif_contract: Chrome debugger flat sessions with recursive Target.setAutoAttach for nested out-of-process iframes
hard_target_fallback: Accessibility.getFullAXTree + backendDOMNodeId + DOM.getBoxModel + native Input dispatch, activated after resident DOM targeting misses
fast_path_contract: resident incremental DOM/targetRef path remains first; CDP accessibility fallback is not on the normal interaction path
model_roundtrip_contract: playwright_flow executes bounded deterministic browser sequences in one remote Browser Agent task
execution_contract: one_guard: anti_crash only; auth challenges auto-resume; verification evidence-only
browser_window_contract: same Chrome profile and existing normal Chrome window; no dedicated Browser Agent window is created
mv3_heartbeat_contract: chrome.alarms is the periodic task/device heartbeat; authenticated device traffic also refreshes server presence; no in-memory heartbeat setInterval
mcp_viewer_contract: browser_snapshot result drives the MCP Apps viewer via tool result metadata; the widget never polls browser_snapshot
